# Student Management System

A console-based Student Management System built using Java, JDBC, Maven, and MySQL. This application allows users to perform CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on student records stored in a MySQL database.

## Features

- Add a new student
- View all students
- Search student by ID
- Update student details
- Delete student
- Input validation
- Exception handling
- MySQL database integration using JDBC

## Technologies Used

- Java
- JDBC
- MySQL
- Maven
- Git & GitHub
- Eclipse IDE

## Database Schema

Database Name:

```
student_management
```

Table:

```sql
CREATE TABLE students (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT,
    name VARCHAR(100),
    age INT,
    department VARCHAR(100),
    marks INT
);
```

## How to Run

1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/<your-repository>.git
```

2. Open the project in Eclipse or any Java IDE.

3. Create the MySQL database and table.

4. Update your database credentials in:

```
DBConnection.java
```

5. Run

```
Main.java
```
